title: Kilauea Ep49 Forecast June 14-15 Most Likely — Summit Reinflation Accelerating
snippet: Kilauea volcano not erupting; Ep48 ended June 1 after record 9h 650ft fountaining. Summit reinflation accelerating. Models forecast Ep49 June 13-16, most likely June 14-15. ADVISORY/YELLOW maintained. Most episodic-fountaining eruption ever recorded at Kilauea (48 episodes, surpassing Pu'u'O'o 1983-86 record of 47).
tag_reason: evt-202 Kilauea series tracked since 2026-05-10. New information: Ep49 forecast window narrowed to June 14-15 (today), reinflation rate data.
